title: Separate a reusable preparation objective from a present visible task
statement: At the same fixed source, one prepared state fed to any common permitted future controller has available distance between exp(-1)(cosh(epsilon)-1)/2 and exp(-1)[cosh(epsilon)-1+2epsilon sinh(epsilon)]/2, while hidden-state TV=exp(-1)sinh(epsilon)/2. Fixed transcript transposition preserves original pre-jump controls; it does not physically reverse a causal feedback controller. A real hidden swap/read port attains the first-order hidden difference.
